candidate.cwe: CWE-94 code injection via a config-selected class import (trust gate bypass)

entry_point: library API: SentenceTransformer / CrossEncoder / SparseEncoder(model_name_or_path) and the public sentence_transformers.util.import_module_class helper

verified.exploit_entry_point: Loading a saved model (Hub id or local directory) through SentenceTransformer / CrossEncoder resolves the class references in its stored configuration; the same resolution is reachable through the public import_module_class helper. All hidden tests run without network; the probe module, the dynamic loader and the model location are local.
variants: T1 plain-import fallback in the shared resolver: local directory, Hub repository id, an existing path that is a file, an absent trust decision (None), and the CrossEncoder loader
T2 saved tokenizer class in a WordEmbeddings module: the model directory is local and the trust decision is absent
T3 nested route type in a Router module inside a saved model
S1 injected activation setting in a saved CNN module
S2 injected processor setting in a saved Transformer module
T4 coupled: a training run restores its own checkpoint for a programmatically built model with a custom module class
verified.project_tests_run: tests/util/test_misc.py (2), tests/base/modules/test_dense.py (3), tests/base/modules/test_router.py -k 'save_load or load_forwards_trust' (6), tests/base/test_model.py -k load_module_class_from_ref (3 after deselecting test_load_module_class_from_ref_fallback_to_import, which encodes the pre-fix fallback behaviour). All 14 pass on the pinned+injected tree and with every passing patch, offline from /opt/hf-cache. The pinned commit predates the upstream regression tests for this advisory (a2258de9 is not an ancestor of the pin and adds tests/util/test_misc.py cases that are absent here).
